state:
**Goal `ext-compiler`, Stage 2 (registration): the fixture and the `--EXTENSION--` case section have landed; the checker layer and the compile entry have not.** The design is ADR 0246 § 8 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; this goal has no record slot.

The fixture `Shop\Ledger` is `tests/conformance/ext/fixtures/ledger/`, packed into the committed `ledger.nvsx` with its pin beside it as `ledger.sha256`. `crates/nvs-ext/tests/fixtures.rs` holds both to the text; its module doc owns the layout and the `NVS_WRITE_FIXTURES=1` rewrite. The checks `nvs-ext-every-conformance-fixture-matches-its-text` and `nvs-test-a-case-loads-a-fixture-extension` are green.

A case writes `--EXTENSION--` with one fixture name per line: `crates/nvs-test/src/case.rs`'s `extension_fixtures` finds `<name>.nvsx` under the nearest `ext/fixtures/` above the case and reads the `.sha256` beside it (nvs-test is std-only, so it cannot hash), and `crates/nvs-test/src/run.rs`'s `write_extensions` copies it and appends the `[[extension]]` entry to `nvs.toml`. The format's home is `crates/nvs-test/src/lib.rs`'s table.

Two gaps in the fixture, both Stage 3's: the named rows of 0246 § 1 (enum, closed union, `Core` value class, `resource`) are absent because the loader refuses them until the manifest carries what they name (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:26`), and `kindOf` (`mixed`) is loaded but never called.

items.text: **The layer** — a new `ext_lib.rs`, shaped like `crates/nvs-types/src/error_lib.rs:86`'s `seed`, seeded after `iter_lib::seed` at `crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:74` from the manifests of the loaded set (`nvs_ext::manifest::Manifest`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/manifest.rs:49`; nvs-types does not depend on nvs-ext yet — check that the manifest half links no wasmtime before adding it). Each method's parameter qualifiers go in the `MethodSig` fields `Core` uses. Tests named by the record: `a_loaded_manifest_class_is_in_the_signature_table`, `an_extension_method_parameter_carries_its_manifest_qualifier_where_core_puts_one`, `an_extension_call_with_a_wrong_argument_type_does_not_compile`, `an_extension_class_constant_has_its_manifest_type`, `an_extension_class_is_unknown_when_the_set_does_not_load_it`, under `crates/nvs-types/tests/`. `rule:packaging/extension-calls-are-statically-typed`.

**The set reaches the compiler** — the compile entry the CLI and the runner share reads the resolved configuration's manifests and hands them to the layer, never instantiating a component; then the two reject cases `tests/conformance/reject/an-extension-call-with-a-wrong-argument-type-does-not-compile.nvst` and `an-extension-class-the-set-does-not-load-does-not-compile.nvst`, each loading `ledger` through `--EXTENSION--`. Anchor: `crates/nvs-types/src/core_lib.rs:73`. `rule:security/extension-manifest-only-tightens`.

backlog: Stage 3: the named rows of 0246 § 1 in the fixture and the loader (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:26`), and a `kindOf` call through the host's `value` resource.
